tasks.description: Create a data retention policy that deletes user activity data 30 days after collection. This policy must be enforced by an automated pipeline and apply to every user activity record without exception.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user activity record, when 30 days have passed since collection, then the record is deleted from the primary event store.

tasks.description: Develop an automated deletion job that enforces the data retention policy. This job should run periodically to ensure no activity data older than 30 days remains in any store.
acceptance_criteria: Given the automated deletion job, when it runs, then all user activity data older than 30 days is deleted from the primary event store.

tasks.description: Design and implement a data archiving solution that retains the complete historical event log indefinitely for trend analysis. This solution should ensure that no activity events are deleted and the event log remains complete and available for querying.
acceptance_criteria: Given the data archiving solution, when querying the event log, then all historical event data is available and queryable.

tasks.description: Implement access controls to restrict access to the primary event store and archived data to authorized personnel only. All access should be logged for auditing purposes.
acceptance_criteria: Given an unauthorized user, when attempting to access the primary event store or archived data, then access is denied and the attempt is logged.

tasks.description: Develop a logging solution that tracks all access to the primary event store and archived data. This solution should ensure that all access is logged for auditing purposes.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user accessing the primary event store or archived data, when the access is logged, then the log entry includes the user's identity, timestamp, and access details.

tasks.description: Create documentation that outlines the data retention policy, including the automated deletion job and data archiving solution. This documentation should be available to stakeholders and authorized personnel.
acceptance_criteria: Given the documentation, when a stakeholder or authorized personnel reads it, then they understand the data retention policy and its implementation.

tasks.summary: Conduct internal audit and compliance review
tasks.description: Perform an internal audit and compliance review to ensure the data retention policy is enforced consistently and stakeholders' needs are met. This review should verify that the system passes both internal audit and compliance review.
acceptance_criteria: Given the internal audit and compliance review, when the review is complete, then the system is found to be compliant with the data retention policy and stakeholders' needs are met.
